business_overview.one_sentence: The Group is a Hong Kong construction contractor engaged in building construction, RMAA works, piling works and supply/sales of prefabricated construction units.

segments.name: construction
segments.description: Single reportable segment; contract works as main contractor or subcontractor, primarily building construction, RMAA works, piling works and prefabricated construction units.

business_overview.revenue_model: Most revenue is recognised over time for construction services; prefabricated construction units are recognised at delivery. Construction payment is generally due within 30 days after payment certificate issuance, with retention until the contract quality assurance period is satisfied.
business_notes: Revenue was derived solely from Hong Kong customers in FY2025.
Unsatisfied performance obligations totalled HK$27,122,782,000 at 31 March 2025.
The Group had performance bond guarantees of HK$563,367,000 at 31 March 2025.

non_recurring_items.item: impairment on property, plant and equipment
non_recurring_items.business_substance: Non-cash impairment on leasehold land of an office building under construction due to downward adjustment of Hong Kong property market.
Bank interest income, mainly return on cash and deposits rather than construction operation.

funds_assets.business_substance: Cash at banks; includes HK$22,796,000 equivalent denominated in RMB.
Short-term time deposits for varying periods from one day to twelve months, deposited with high credit rating banks.
No restricted cash at 31 March 2025; prior-year HK$14,704,000 pledged performance bond deposit was withdrawn during FY2025.
funds_assets.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, balance sheet, cash flow statement and note 24

operating_assets.business_substance: Construction receivables and billed contract amounts.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, consolidated statement of financial position

operating_assets.business_substance: Unbilled revenue and retention receivables from construction contracts; HK$263,063,000 expected after twelve months.
operating_assets.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, statement of financial position and note 21

operating_assets.business_substance: Leasehold land, office building under construction, machinery, construction in progress and other operating assets.

investment_assets.item: financial assets at fair value through profit or loss
investment_assets.business_substance: Cash value of life insurance policies for one executive director and one senior manager; withdrawable at policy cash value.

investment_assets.item: investment in joint ventures and associates
investment_assets.business_substance: Equity-accounted investments; not treated as detachable cash.
investment_assets.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, statement of financial position

other_assets.item: prepayments, other receivables and other assets
other_assets.business_substance: Operating and other receivables not decomposed further for owner earnback purpose.
other_assets.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, statement of financial position

financing_liabilities.business_substance: Secured floating-rate bank loans repayable within one year or on demand.
Lease liabilities included in other payables; treated as continuing operating burden rather than full cash-pool debt deduction.

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Trade payables to subcontractors/suppliers, including retention payables HK$388,942,000 and related-company balances HK$489,307,000.
operating_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, statement of financial position and note 25

operating_liabilities.business_substance: Expected future losses where forecasted contract costs exceed expected contract economic benefits.
No short-term advances from construction customers at 31 March 2025.

other_liabilities.business_substance: Contingent bank guarantees for performance bonds in favour of contract customers.

other_liabilities.item: tax payable and deferred tax liabilities
other_liabilities.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, statement of financial position

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow was consistently above parent net profit, but FY2025 contract assets increased sharply and capital expenditure was elevated because of redevelopment and prefabrication-related assets. Interest income from detachable funds is excluded from sustainable operating cash profit.

evidence.source: Annual Report 2024-2025, consolidated statement of profit or loss, HK$'000
Annual Report 2024-2025, consolidated statement of cash flows, HK$'000

evidence.metric: FY2024 and FY2023 comparative cash flow
evidence.source: Annual Report 2023-2024, consolidated statement of cash flows, HK$'000

gaps: Annual report does not provide parent/subsidiary-level cash split for Hong Kong operating subsidiaries; detachable cash haircut and necessary operating cash are therefore conservative estimates.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not explicitly disclosed; maintenance capex uses a conservative estimate based on depreciation and recurring operating asset needs.
Market capitalisation is taken from input rough screen, not independently time-stamped by exchange data.
